_source: Mongoose Traveller 2e Core Rulebook Update 2022, printed pp46, 48, 49. PDF page = printed page - 7.

benefits.when: gained when a Traveller leaves a career, for any reason
benefits.rolls: one Benefit roll per FULL term served in that career, plus extra rolls for high rank
benefits.lost_roll: a failed Survival roll costs the Benefit roll for that term
benefits._cash_limit_note: maximum three Cash-column rolls across ALL careers, for the whole Traveller
benefits.gambler_dm: a Traveller with the Gambler skill gains DM+1 to all Cash column rolls

benefits_of_rank.extra: DM+1 to all Benefit rolls from this career

benefits.leftover_cash: may purchase personal equipment worth up to Cr10000 before play begins; leftover money can be converted to cash, trade goods or simply saved
benefits._equipment_conflict: The standalone Character Generation Flowchart game aid says 'spend up to Cr 2,000'. The book (printed p46) says Cr10000. THE BOOK WINS -- this is the third recorded disagreement between that game aid and the rulebook.

ship_shares.meaning: contacts, credit rating, savings and favours worth roughly one millionth of a space vessel each; pooled toward ownership
ship_shares.not_cash: Ship Shares cannot be traded or redeemed for cash
ship_shares.if_unused: if not used to help purchase a ship, each unused Ship Share instead yields an additional pension of Cr1000 per year

tas_membership.once_only: membership may only be received once per Traveller
tas_membership.duplicate: rolling this Benefit again yields two Ship Shares instead
tas_membership.dividend: one high passage every two months, which may be used, retained or sold

yacht.first: a yacht with 25% of the mortgage paid off; roll 1D on the Spacecraft Quirks table
yacht.duplicate: each further roll pays off another 25%; four times clears the mortgage entirely
yacht.alternative: a Safari Ship may be selected instead

benefits.ships_rule: for simplicity and balance only one Traveller may begin play in possession of a ship; each other Traveller who rolled a ship receives an additional pension of Cr25000 per year instead, representing part ownership

pensions.eligibility: leaving a career after at least FIVE terms in it counts as retirement and earns a pension
pensions.payment: paid at the beginning of each year, effective on leaving the service, collectible at any Class A or B starport

ageing.when: at the end of the fourth term and at the end of every term thereafter
ageing.roll: 2D minus the Traveller's TOTAL number of terms
ageing.player_choice: the Traveller chooses which characteristics are affected

table.effect: reduce three physical characteristics by 2, and one mental characteristic by 1
reduce two physical characteristics by 2, and one physical characteristic by 1
reduce one physical characteristic by 2, and two physical characteristics by 1

ageing_crisis.outcome: the Traveller dies unless they pay 1D x Cr10000 for medical care, which restores any such characteristics to 1
ageing_crisis.aftermath: the Traveller automatically fails all qualification rolls from then on

anagathics.start: at the start of any career term, roll SOC 10+ to begin taking anagathics
anagathics.fumble: a roll of exactly 2 sends the Traveller straight to the Prisoner career for that term
anagathics.effect: while using them the Traveller effectively does not age -- add the number of terms since starting anagathics as a POSITIVE DM to Ageing rolls
anagathics.stopping: if the Traveller stops for any reason they must roll immediately on the Ageing table
anagathics.drawback_survival: must make TWO Survival checks each term instead of one; if either or both fail, the Traveller suffers a Mishap
anagathics.drawback_cost: 1D x Cr25000 per term, paid out of eventual cash benefits; if unpayable the Traveller goes into debt

injuries.when: Travellers wounded in combat or accidents during creation roll on the Injury table

table.name: Nearly killed
table.effect: reduce one physical characteristic by 1D and two other physical characteristics by 2

medical_care._note: Cr5000 to restore each lost characteristic point
medical_care.employer_cover: if injured in the service of an organisation, roll 2D on the Medical Bills table adding your rank as a DM; the result is the percentage of the cost the employer pays
medical_care.unpaid: any balance the Traveller cannot pay becomes a starting debt

life_events.name: Sickness or Injury
life_events.text: You are injured or become sick. Roll on the Injury table.

life_events.name: Birth or Death
life_events.text: Someone close to you dies, or someone close to you gives birth. You are involved in some fashion.

life_events.name: Ending of Relationship
life_events.text: A romantic relationship involving you ends badly. Gain a Rival or Enemy.

life_events.name: Improved Relationship
life_events.text: A romantic relationship deepens, possibly leading to marriage or another commitment. Gain an Ally.

life_events.name: New Relationship
life_events.text: You become involved in a romantic relationship. Gain an Ally.

life_events.name: Betrayal
life_events.text: You are betrayed by a friend. Convert a Contact or Ally into a Rival or Enemy; otherwise gain a Rival or Enemy.

life_events.name: Travel
life_events.text: You move to another world. Gain DM+2 to your next qualification roll.

life_events.name: Good Fortune
life_events.text: Something good happens to you. Gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll.

life_events.name: Crime
life_events.text: You commit, suffer or are accused of a crime. Lose one Benefit roll or take the Prisoner career next term.

life_events.name: Unusual Event
life_events.text: Roll 1D on the Unusual Events sub-table.

subtable.name: Psionics
subtable.text: You encounter a Psionic institute. You may immediately test your Psionic Strength and, if you qualify, take the Psion career next term.

subtable.name: Aliens
subtable.text: You spend time among an alien species. Gain Science 1 and a Contact among an alien species.

subtable.name: Alien Artefact
subtable.text: You have a strange device from an alien culture, not normally available to humans.

subtable.name: Amnesia
subtable.text: Something happened to you but you do not know what it was.

subtable.name: Contact with Government
subtable.text: You briefly came into contact with the highest echelons of the Imperium.

subtable.name: Ancient Technology
subtable.text: You have something older than the Imperium, or older than humanity.
